keyPoints.en: Weathering: physical, chemical, biological — rocks break down in place.
keyPoints.bm: Luluhawa: fizikal, kimia, biologi — batuan pecah di tempatnya.

keyPoints.en: In Malaysia's hot, wet climate chemical weathering is common, forming thick soils.
keyPoints.bm: Dalam iklim panas lembap Malaysia, luluhawa kimia biasa berlaku, membentuk tanih yang tebal.

keyPoints.en: Upper: V-shaped valley, waterfalls, rapids. Middle: meanders. Lower: floodplain, oxbow lake. Mouth: delta/estuary.
keyPoints.bm: Hulu: lurah V, air terjun, jeram. Tengah: meander. Hilir: dataran banjir, tasik ladam. Muara: delta/kuala.

keyPoints.en: Outer bend erodes; inner bend deposits. Floodplains are fertile (alluvium).
keyPoints.bm: Tebing luar terhakis; tebing dalam memendap. Dataran banjir subur (aluvium).

keyPoints.en: Coastal erosion: crack → cave → arch → stack → stump. Deposition: beach, spit, sand bar.
keyPoints.bm: Hakisan pinggir laut: rekahan → gua → gerbang laut → batu tunggul → tunggul batu. Pemendapan: pantai, anak tanjung, beting pasir.

keyPoints.en: Limestone dissolves in rainwater: caves, stalactites (hang), stalagmites (rise) — e.g. Gunung Mulu, Batu Caves.
keyPoints.bm: Batu kapur larut dalam air hujan: gua, stalaktit (tergantung), stalagmit (tumbuh dari bawah) — cth. Gunung Mulu, Batu Caves.

tip.en: StalaCtite holds tight to the Ceiling; stalaGmite grows up from the Ground.
tip.bm: StalaKtit di Kepala (atas); stalaGmit di Ground/bawah.
